title: Adolescence: A Time of Change
summary: Puberty, the growth spurt, hormones, emotional changes, hygiene, nutrition and looking after yourself.

ib.note: Links to MYP Physical and Health Education

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 6: Adolescence: A Stage of Growth and Change
Earlier NCERT Ch 10: Reaching the Age of Adolescence

objectives: I can describe the physical and emotional changes of adolescence.
I can explain the role of hormones in puberty.
I can describe how to stay healthy during adolescence: nutrition, hygiene, rest, and seeking help.
misconceptions: Everyone goes through puberty at the same age.
Puberty changes are something to be embarrassed about.
You should never talk about these changes.
